items.title: Windows Graphics Vulnerabilities Allow Remote Attackers to Execute Arbitrary Code
items.description: Multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft’s Graphics Device Interface (GDI), a core component of the Windows operating system responsible for rendering graphics. These flaws, discovered by Check Point through an intensive fuzzing campaign targeting Enhanced Metafile (EMF) formats, could enable remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or steal sensitive data.
